title: Summative Test 1 — Earth, Greenhouse & Philippine Geology

questions.text: What fraction of Earth's surface is covered by water?
What is Earth's average surface temperature?
What would Earth's average temperature be WITHOUT the natural greenhouse effect?
Which planet has a runaway greenhouse effect and is the hottest in the Solar System?
Why is liquid water essential for life on Earth?
options: It acts as a universal solvent for chemical reactions and transports nutrients
It is rare in the universe
questions.correct: It acts as a universal solvent for chemical reactions and transports nutrients

questions.text: What layer of the atmosphere contains the ozone layer that protects us from UV radiation?
What generates Earth's protective magnetic field?
Why is Earth's distance from the Sun called the 'Goldilocks zone'?
options: It's not too hot and not too cold — just right for liquid water
It's the closest planet to the Sun
It matches the color of gold
questions.correct: It's not too hot and not too cold — just right for liquid water

questions.text: Why does ice float on water, and why is this important for life?
options: Ice is less dense than water and insulates the water below, letting aquatic life survive winter
Floating ice has no effect on life
questions.correct: Ice is less dense than water and insulates the water below, letting aquatic life survive winter

questions.text: What is the greenhouse effect?
options: Gases in the atmosphere trap infrared radiation, warming Earth's surface
Cooling of the atmosphere by clouds
questions.correct: Gases in the atmosphere trap infrared radiation, warming Earth's surface

questions.text: What kind of radiation do greenhouse gases absorb?
Which greenhouse gas is the MOST abundant naturally in Earth's atmosphere?
Which human activity is the MAIN source of carbon dioxide emissions?
options: Burning fossil fuels for electricity and transportation
questions.correct: Burning fossil fuels for electricity and transportation

questions.text: Approximately how much more potent is methane (CH₄) at trapping heat than carbon dioxide?
What is the DIFFERENCE between the natural and enhanced greenhouse effect?
options: Natural is caused by naturally occurring GHGs; enhanced is caused by human-added GHGs
Natural is bad, enhanced is good
Natural only happens in the tropics
questions.correct: Natural is caused by naturally occurring GHGs; enhanced is caused by human-added GHGs

questions.text: What is the theory that Earth's outer shell is broken into moving plates called?
At which type of plate boundary do volcanoes MOST commonly form?
The Philippine Fault System is an example of which plate boundary type?
How were the Philippine islands primarily formed?
options: Through volcanic arcs, collisions, and tectonic uplift over millions of years
They were carried by ocean currents
They are fragments of the Moon
They were always a single big island
questions.correct: Through volcanic arcs, collisions, and tectonic uplift over millions of years

questions.text: What is the Pacific Ring of Fire?
options: A horseshoe-shaped zone around the Pacific where most volcanoes and earthquakes occur
A ring of fire in Hawaii
questions.correct: A horseshoe-shaped zone around the Pacific where most volcanoes and earthquakes occur

questions.text: Why are marine fossils found on Philippine mountains?
options: The ocean once covered the area, and tectonic uplift raised the land above sea level
Fish used to live on land
questions.correct: The ocean once covered the area, and tectonic uplift raised the land above sea level

questions.text: Which geological feature is east of Mindanao and reaches depths over 10,000 meters?
Which of the following landforms is a karst landscape with an underground river?
How many climate types does PAGASA classify in the Philippines?
Which monsoon wind brings cool, dry weather from November to February?
About how many tropical cyclones enter Philippine waters each year?
What is the Coral Triangle?
options: A marine region including the Philippines with 2,500+ fish species and 500+ coral species
A political alliance of three countries
questions.correct: A marine region including the Philippines with 2,500+ fish species and 500+ coral species

questions.text: About what percentage of Philippine plants are endemic (found only in the Philippines)?
Which iconic Philippine species is one of the largest eagles in the world and is critically endangered?
Which of the following is the MOST serious threat to Philippine biodiversity?
options: Habitat loss from deforestation, mining, and land conversion
questions.correct: Habitat loss from deforestation, mining, and land conversion
